page.layout: One page of text, with a marginal note in the right margin beside the first canon. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Catchword at the foot right.

main_text.p: exceptis, reliqua omnia Imperia & Regna suo dominio subjecit.
main_text.head: Periodus IV.
Canon I.
main_text.p: Imperium Macedonicum in Tandē divisumAsiam, Thraciam, Macedoniam, Syriam & Ægyptum dividitur.
main_text.head: Explicatio 1.
main_text.p: Causa fuit divisionis ambigua illa Alexandri moribundi vox: qui interrogatus quemnam successorem relinqueret, respondit: dignissimum. Unde quanquam & Fratrem & duos Filios & Filiam haberet, tamen quod ille vecors, hi autem impuberes es-sent, proceres atq; duces sibi imperium, veluti palmam, esse propositum existimarunt, & illud fore fortissimi atque fortunatissimi præ-mium.
main_text.head: Explicatio. 2.

page.notes: The left edge shows fragments of the neighbouring page and is left out. The marginal note "Tandē divisum" is set at the top right; the stray "in" at the end of the canon line sits at the column edge and may belong to the note, so it is copied as in the text. The running text ends with a catchword "xan-" in the foot right. The "Explicatio 2." paragraph ends with the word split "Ale-" / "xan-"; the catchword is copied as printed. Long s printed as f has been rendered as s (e.g. "Caufa" as "Causa"). Headings for Periodus and Canon are set as level 2 and the Explicatio labels as level 3 by judgement.
